title: New Improved Schwarzschild Black Hole and Its Thermodynamics and Topological Classification
summary: We construct a renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild-like black hole geometry using the exact new scheme running for the Newton coupling. The scale identification is implemented via a standard interpolating proper-distance function governed by an interpolation parameter $γ$ that smoothly connects the ultraviolet and infrared regimes. We present the resulting coordinate-dependent coupling and the improved metric function, analyzing its asymptotic expansions.
